Shown where an AI tool or Save and check reports its failure. {provider} is the AI service's name (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) or, for a service added by address, its host name.

aiService.stoppedIncomplete.description: The AI service's answer was cut off and the service gave no reason. Shown where an AI tool or Save and check reports its failure. {provider} is the AI service's name (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) or, for a service added by address, its host name.

aiService.notJson.description: The AI service's answer could not be read. Shown where an AI tool or Save and check reports its failure. {provider} is the AI service's name (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) or, for a service added by address, its host name.

aiService.emptyAnswer.description: The AI service answered with nothing. Shown where an AI tool or Save and check reports its failure. {provider} is the AI service's name (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) or, for a service added by address, its host name.

aiService.uploadSlow.description: Making captions with Gemini: the uploaded sound was not ready in time. Shown where an AI tool or Save and check reports its failure. {provider} is the AI service's name (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) or, for a service added by address, its host name.

aiService.uploadFailed.description: Making captions with Gemini: the service could not use the uploaded sound. Shown where an AI tool or Save and check reports its failure. {provider} is the AI service's name (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) or, for a service added by address, its host name.

aiService.rejectedJsonMode.description: A service added by address refused every way of asking for a JSON answer. Shown where an AI tool or Save and check reports its failure. {provider} is the AI service's name (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) or, for a service added by address, its host name.

aiService.jsonModeRefused.description: A service added by address refused one way of asking for a JSON answer; Flown then tries the next way, so this shows only when a later request fails the same way.

listFetch.redirect.description: An AI service sent a request on to another address, which Flown refuses (so the key is never sent elsewhere). Shown where the AI tool or the model list reports its failure, after the service's name and a colon in the model list.

listFetch.couldNotRead.description: Settings › AI providers, the model list: reading the service's answer failed; {reason} is the system's own words for why. {provider} is the AI service's name or, for a service added by address, its host name.

listFetch.tooLarge.description: Settings › AI providers, the model list: the service sent more than Flown reads. {provider} is the AI service's name or, for a service added by address, its host name.

listFetch.notJson.description: Settings › AI providers, the model list: the service's answer could not be read. {provider} is the AI service's name or, for a service added by address, its host name.

serviceStore.newAddress.description: Settings › AI providers: a service's address was changed, and its key must be entered again.

serviceStore.model.description: Settings › AI providers: a service was saved without a model name.

aiService.noPictures.description: An AI tool asked to send screenshots to a model that does not take pictures. "Also send the screenshots" is the checkbox's label (smart.guide).

download.mismatch.description: Settings › Caption fonts: a downloaded font was not the file Flown expected, so it was not kept.

download.cancelled.description: Settings › Caption fonts: the user stopped a font download.

download.stopped.description: Caption fonts and the music library: a download broke off; {reason} is a sentence saying why (such as "The connection was closed.").

download.refusedGithub.description: Caption fonts and the music library: the download address answered 403.

download.fontGone.description: Settings › Caption fonts: the font's download address is gone; {status} is the HTTP status number, in Latin digits.

download.musicGone.description: Audio › Music library: the track's download address is gone; {status} is the HTTP status number, in Latin digits.

clipboard.failedBecause.description: Copy to clipboard: the copy tool could not start; {reason} is the system's own words for why. Shown in the export dialog's done view after Copy to clipboard.

clipboard.timedOut.description: Copy to clipboard: the copy tool did not finish in time. Shown in the export dialog's done view after Copy to clipboard.

clipboard.failedSaying.description: Copy to clipboard: the copy tool failed and printed {output}, its own words (often English). Shown in the export dialog's done view after Copy to clipboard.

clipboard.failed.description: Copy to clipboard: the copy tool failed without saying why. Shown in the export dialog's done view after Copy to clipboard.

clipboard.fileGone.description: Copy to clipboard: the file was moved or deleted after the export. Shown in the export dialog's done view after Copy to clipboard.

clipboard.noTool.description: Copy to clipboard on Linux without a copy tool. Shown in the export dialog's done view after Copy to clipboard.

clipboard.notExported.description: Copy to clipboard: the file asked for was not exported by this run of Flown. Shown in the export dialog's done view after Copy to clipboard.

musicLoop.failed.description: Export: the looping background music could not be decoded. "Loop" is the Audio panel's toggle.

musicLoop.timedOut.description: Export: decoding the looping background music did not finish in time.

musicLoop.space.description: Export: the disk is too full for the looping music's decoded copy; {mb} is a whole number of megabytes.

speechHelper.missing.description: Why the speech engine (captions on this PC, the speech detector) cannot run: this build has no helper program. Settings shows it in brackets after the detector's name, with its first letter lower case and no full stop in English.

speechHelper.cpu.description: Why the speech engine cannot run on this PC's processor. Settings shows it in brackets after the detector's name, with its first letter lower case and no full stop in English.

speechHelper.checkFailed.description: Why the speech engine cannot run: its start-up check failed; {why} is a technical reason (an exit code, a signal, or the helper's own words).

speechHelper.checkFailedSaying.description: Why the speech engine cannot run: its start-up check failed; {why} is a technical reason and {said} the helper's last line of output, in its own (English) words.

speechHelper.tooMuchOutput.description: Technical reason inside "The speech helper's check failed (…)": the helper printed more than {bytes} bytes (a number in Latin digits).

speechHelper.lineTooLong.description: Technical reason inside "The speech helper's check failed (…)": one line of the helper's output was longer than {bytes} bytes (a number in Latin digits).

speechHelper.exitCode.description: Technical reason in brackets: the speech helper ended with exit code {code} (a number or a hexadecimal code such as 0xC000001D, in Latin digits).

speechHelper.signal.description: Technical reason in brackets: the speech helper was ended by the system signal {signal} (such as SIGSEGV).

vad.helperMissing.description: Settings › Captions on this PC, the speech detector's line: why the detector cannot run, a clause shown in brackets ("Speech detector: not available on this PC (…)"), so it starts lower case and has no full stop.

vad.modelDamaged.description: Settings › Captions on this PC, the speech detector's line: why the detector cannot run, a clause shown in brackets ("Speech detector: not available on this PC (…)"), so it starts lower case and has no full stop. "its" is the speech detector's.

vad.didNotStart.description: Settings › Captions on this PC, the speech detector's line: why the detector cannot run, a clause shown in brackets ("Speech detector: not available on this PC (…)"), so it starts lower case and has no full stop.

vad.processor.description: Settings › Captions on this PC, the speech detector's line: why the detector cannot run, a clause shown in brackets ("Speech detector: not available on this PC (…)"), so it starts lower case and has no full stop.

soundsIpc.readFailed.description: Audio › Find unwanted sounds: reading the recording's sound failed; {reason} is ffmpeg's last line of output, in its own (English) words.

soundsIpc.readFailedCode.description: Audio › Find unwanted sounds: reading the recording's sound failed without a message; {code} is ffmpeg's exit code, in Latin digits.

soundsIpc.idle.description: Audio › Find unwanted sounds: the recording's sound was not read for a while, so Flown stopped reading it (shown as why finding sounds failed). No full stop, like the other sound stream reasons.

voice.failed.description: Clean voice failed: shown in the Audio panel and in a failed export, followed by the reason.

voice.missingMic.description: Clean voice: a reason main gives why the voice could not be cleaned, shown after "Your voice could not be cleaned." in the Audio panel and in a failed export.

voice.missingMix.description: Clean voice: a reason main gives why the voice could not be cleaned, shown after "Your voice could not be cleaned." in the Audio panel and in a failed export.

voice.tooLong.description: Clean voice: a reason main gives why the voice could not be cleaned, shown after "Your voice could not be cleaned." in the Audio panel and in a failed export.

voice.locked.description: Clean voice: a reason main gives why the voice could not be cleaned, shown after "Your voice could not be cleaned." in the Audio panel and in a failed export.

voice.unplayable.description: Clean voice: the editor's own reason, after "Your voice could not be cleaned.": the cleaned file is there but does not play.

voice.engine.description: Clean voice: a reason main gives why the voice could not be cleaned, shown after "Your voice could not be cleaned." in the Audio panel and in a failed export. Sometimes followed by a technical detail in brackets.

voice.damagedModel.description: Clean voice: a reason main gives why the voice could not be cleaned, shown after "Your voice could not be cleaned." in the Audio panel and in a failed export.

voice.cancelled.description: Clean voice was stopped (Cancel, or the editor closed) while an export waited for it: shown after "Your voice could not be cleaned." in the failed export.

voice.replaced.description: Clean voice was restarted for another strength while an export waited for it: shown after "Your voice could not be cleaned." in the failed export.

localAi.notInBuild.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): why it cannot run.

localAi.processorOld.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): why it cannot run.

localAi.processorUnknown.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): why it cannot run.

localAi.noModel.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): no model is downloaded.

localAi.stalled.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): the model stopped answering.

localAi.needsMemory.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): why a model cannot be downloaded: it needs {need} GB of memory and the PC has {have} GB (no full stop in Settings; main adds one when it refuses).

localAi.freeMemorySmall.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): not enough free memory to run now; the Small model is not downloaded. {need} and {free} are gigabytes with one decimal.

localAi.freeMemory.description: Settings › AI on this PC and the AI tools, about AI on this PC (a model that runs on this computer): not enough free memory to run now. {need} and {free} are gigabytes with one decimal.

printPdf.tooLong.description: Make a guide › Save as PDF: why no PDF was saved: printing the guide to PDF ran out of time.

notesIpc.unknownHotkey.description: Hotkeys: a hotkey was checked for an action Flown does not know (a programming error the settings show as is).

notesIpc.hotkeyTaken.description: Hotkeys: the keys chosen are already another action's hotkey. {key} is the key combination as keycaps ("Ctrl + Shift + F6", never translated); {action} is the other action's name.

notesIpc.hotkeyUsedElsewhere.description: Hotkeys: the keys chosen are held by another app on this PC. {key} is the key combination as keycaps (never translated).

notesIpc.hotkeyInvalid.description: Hotkeys: Windows refused the keys chosen as a hotkey. {key} is the key combination as keycaps (never translated).

projectCopy.busy.description: Duplicate: why a copy was not made, after "Could not make the copy: " (review.copy.failed {reason}); lower case because it ends that sentence.

projectCopy.unreadable.description: Duplicate: why a copy was not made, after "Could not make the copy: " (review.copy.failed {reason}).

projectCopy.noFolder.description: Duplicate: why a copy was not made, after "Could not make the copy: ". {app} is the app's name (Flown); "Videos\{app}" is the folder's path and stays as is.

projectCopy.noSpace.description: Duplicate: why a copy was not made, after "Could not make the copy: ". {needs} and {free} are sizes in gigabytes with one decimal.

shareStore.store.mac.description: Settings › Share: the macOS feature that keeps webhooks safe, in "{what} is not available" (errors.shareStore.webhooksCannotBeStored).

versions.notAFolder.description: Versions: the recording's versions folder is a file or a link, so no version is kept.

versions.recordingGone.description: Versions: the recording's folder was removed, so no version is kept.

versions.unknown.description: Versions: a version id Flown does not know was asked for.

versions.unknownReason.description: Versions: an automatic version was asked for with a reason Flown does not know.

versions.cannotKeep.description: Versions: the edit could not be read as a project, so it is not kept.

versions.tooLarge.description: Versions: the edit is larger than a version may be.

versions.tooMany.description: Versions: Keep a version when the most saved versions (VERSION_LIMITS.named) are already kept; {n} is that number.

versions.gone.description: Versions: the version asked for was deleted (its file is gone).

versions.unreadable.description: Versions: the version's file is damaged or too large.

import.extension.description: Import a video: the file's name does not end in a video extension Flown takes.

import.cannotOpen.description: Import a video: the file could not be opened at all.

import.empty.description: Import a video: the file has (almost) no bytes.

import.tooLarge.description: Import a video: the file is larger than Flown imports.

import.notVideo.description: Import a video: the file's first bytes are no video container; {ext} is its extension as named.

import.unreadable.description: Import a video: ffmpeg could not read the file as a video.

import.soundOnly.description: Import a video: the file holds sound only. "Audio" is the inspector tab of that name.

import.noVideo.description: Import a video: the file holds no picture and no sound.

import.drm.description: Import a video: the video is protected.

import.codec.description: Import a video: the video's codec is one ffmpeg cannot decode; {codec} is its technical name.

import.tooShort.description: Import a video: the video is shorter than half a second.

import.tooLong.description: Import a video: the video is longer than Flown imports.

import.size.description: Import a video: the picture is smaller or larger than Flown edits; {w} × {h} is its size in pixels.

import.narrow.description: Import a video: the picture is more than ten times as wide as high, or the other way; {w} × {h} is its size in pixels.

import.space.description: Import a video: {needed} and {free} are sizes ("5.7 GB", "640 MB").

import.busy.description: Import a video: one import runs at a time.

import.several.description: Import a video: several files were dropped at once.

import.diskFull.description: Import a video: the drive filled up while the editing copy was made.

import.incomplete.description: Import a video: the file changed or went away while it was read.

import.failed.description: Import a video: making the editing copy failed, with no detail.

import.failedDetail.description: Import a video: making the editing copy failed; {detail} is ffmpeg's own (English) reason.

import.noteTracks.description: Import a video: a note on the imported project when the video has two or more sound tracks; {n} is how many.

import.noteNoSound.description: Import a video: a note on the imported project.

import.noteHdr.description: Import a video: a note on the imported project.

import.noteHdrPale.description: Import a video: a note on the imported project.

import.noteScaled.description: Import a video: a note on the imported project; {w} × {h} is the editing copy's size in pixels.

import.noteCapped.description: Import a video: a note on the imported project.

scriptDraft.answer.notText.description: Draft script: why the AI's answer was not used, in the brackets of "The AI's answer could not be used ({detail})".

cubeLut.repeats.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: a keyword is given twice.

cubeLut.titleQuotes.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: TITLE is a keyword of the file format, kept as is.

cubeLut.textAfterTitle.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: TITLE is a keyword of the file format.

cubeLut.titleTooLong.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: TITLE is a keyword of the file format; {max} the limit.

cubeLut.rangeTwice.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: both LUT_3D_INPUT_RANGE and DOMAIN_MIN/MAX are given.

cubeLut.unknownKeyword.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: a keyword Flown does not know.

cubeLut.dataBeforeSize.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: LUT_3D_SIZE is a keyword of the file format.

cubeLut.oneDomain.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: DOMAIN_MIN and DOMAIN_MAX are keywords of the file format.

cubeLut.extraLine.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: more data lines than the sizes say; {total} is how many, grouped.

cubeLut.rowCount.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: a data line has not three values; {n} is how many.

cubeLut.noSize.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: the file gives no size.

cubeLut.endsEarly.description: Colour › Import a LUT: why a .cube file was refused: the data stops early; {rows} lines were read of {total}, grouped.

fonts.unreadable.description: Brand kit and Fonts: a font file whose bytes are no font Flown takes.

fonts.misnamed.ttf.description: Brand kit and Fonts: the file's extension says another type than its bytes; {named} is its extension as named.

fonts.misnamed.otf.description: Brand kit and Fonts: the file's extension says another type than its bytes; {named} is its extension as named.

fonts.misnamed.woff2.description: Brand kit and Fonts: the file's extension says another type than its bytes; {named} is its extension as named.

autosave.locked.description: Saving failed: the project file could not be written (the system code follows in brackets, e.g. "(EBUSY)").

autosave.readOnly.description: Saving failed: the drive cannot be written (the system code follows in brackets, "(EROFS)").

imported.noCursorRecorded.description: The editor's notice when a cursor feature (e.g. Smooth cursor) is asked for and the recording has no cursor data; no full stop (the notice adds none).

imported.cursor.description: Cursor panel: the hint for a project imported from a video file (Import a video), which has no recorded cursor.

imported.autoZoom.description: Zoom panel: the hint for an imported video under Auto zoom. The panel follows it with " (or press Z)" (the Add zoom shortcut) and a full stop, so it ends without one.

imported.keystrokes.description: Effects panel › Key presses: the hint for a project imported from a video file.

imported.camera.description: Camera panel: the hint for a project imported from a video file (no camera recording of its own).

imported.noCursor.description: The editor's notice when a cursor feature is asked for in a project imported from a video file; no full stop (the notice adds none).

search.momentCut.description: The editor's notice after opening a moment found by Home's search that was cut from the edit: the playhead is at the next kept part.

search.momentCutEnd.description: The editor's notice after opening a moment found by Home's search that was cut after the last kept part: the playhead is at the end.

aiFailure.timeout.description: A request to an AI service failed: no answer in time. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.network.description: A request to an AI service failed: the connection failed. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.certificate.description: A request to an AI service failed: the service's certificate was refused in the handshake (a company's TLS inspection or a proxy). {code} is the TLS error code, kept as it is. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.auth.description: A request to an AI service failed: the API key was refused. "Settings → AI providers" names the place in Settings. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.rateLimit.description: A request to an AI service failed: too many requests for now (HTTP 429). {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.quota.description: A request to an AI service failed: the account has no credit left. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.noAccessModel.description: A request to an AI service failed: the key may not use the model (HTTP 403). {model} is the model's name. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.noAccessApi.description: A request to an AI service failed: the key may not use that part of the service (HTTP 403), no model named. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.unknownModelNamed.description: A request to an AI service failed: the model is unknown to the service (HTTP 404). {model} is the model's name. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.unknownModel.description: A request to an AI service failed: the model is unknown to the service (HTTP 404), no model named. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.tooLarge.description: A request to an AI service failed: the sound sent was larger than the service takes (HTTP 413). {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.server.description: A request to an AI service failed: the service had an error of its own. {status} is the HTTP status number, kept in Latin digits. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.rejectedSaying.description: A request to an AI service failed: the service refused the request (HTTP 400). {detail} is the service's own message, as it wrote it. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.rejected.description: A request to an AI service failed: the service refused the request (HTTP 400) without saying why. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.failedSaying.description: A request to an AI service failed: any other failure. {detail} is what went wrong, as the service or the system wrote it. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

aiFailure.failed.description: A request to an AI service failed: any other failure, with nothing more to say. {provider} is the service's name as shown (OpenAI, Google Gemini, a service the user added).

localCaptions.reason.missing.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why the speech engine cannot run, inside the brackets of "Speech engine: not available (…)". Part of the app is missing.

localCaptions.reason.cpu.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why the speech engine cannot run, inside the brackets of "Speech engine: not available (…)". The processor is too old.

localCaptions.reason.blocked.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why the speech engine cannot run, inside the brackets of "Speech engine: not available (…)". Windows or an antivirus refused to start it.

localCaptions.reason.failed.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why the speech engine cannot run, inside the brackets of "Speech engine: not available (…)". It did not start for another reason.

localCaptions.unavailable.missing.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine is missing from this copy of Flown.

localCaptions.unavailable.cpu.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the processor cannot run the speech engine.

localCaptions.unavailable.blocked.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): Windows or an antivirus refused to start the speech engine.

localCaptions.unavailable.failed.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine did not start.

localCaptions.tierLabel.description: A speech model as the Captions tab names it: its tier (Fast, Standard, Accurate, Most accurate, Bangla) and then the model's own name once, in brackets ("Standard (Whisper base)").

localCaptions.noModel.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model is not downloaded. {model} names it ("Standard (Whisper base)"); {size} its download size ("142 MB").

localCaptions.damaged.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model file failed its check. {model} names it; {size} its download size.

localCaptions.crashedAt.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine crashed twice on one part. {part} and {parts} are numbers; "Generate captions" names the button.

localCaptions.crashed.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine crashed twice. "Generate captions" names the button.

localCaptions.memoryTry.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the PC ran out of memory. {model} names the model; {tier} the next quicker tier ("Standard").

localCaptions.memory.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the PC ran out of memory and there is no quicker tier. {model} names the model.

localCaptions.stalled.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine stopped answering. "Generate captions" names the button.

localCaptions.protocol.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the speech engine gave an answer Flown cannot read.

localCaptions.language.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model does not know the spoken language asked for. {language} is its code; "Detect automatically" names a choice of the spoken language list.

localCaptions.blockedMemory.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model may not run on this PC for lack of memory. {model} names it; {gb} is a number.

localCaptions.blockedProcessor.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the model would be too slow on this processor. {model} names it.

localCaptions.outdated.description: Captions on this PC could not be made (shown after "Captions could not be made: "): the bundled speech engine is from another version of Flown. {model} names the model.

localCaptions.modelProcessor.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why a speech model cannot be downloaded on this PC (its processor).

localCaptions.modelMemory.description: Settings › Captions on this PC: why a speech model cannot be downloaded on this PC (its memory). {need} is a decimal number of GB, {gb} and {have} whole numbers.

pinnedDownload.notAllowed.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the address is not one Flown downloads from.

pinnedDownload.space.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the disk has too little free space. {mb} is a whole number of megabytes.

pinnedDownload.stalled.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: nothing arrived for a minute.

pinnedDownload.tooManyRedirects.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server sent it on too many times.

pinnedDownload.badRedirect.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server sent it on to an address that is not valid.

pinnedDownload.hostNotAllowed.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server sent it on to a host Flown does not download from. {host} is that host's name.

pinnedDownload.busy.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server stayed busy longer than Flown waits.

pinnedDownload.refused.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server or a proxy refused it.

pinnedDownload.missing.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the file is gone from its address. {status} is the HTTP status number.

pinnedDownload.httpStatus.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server answered with an error. {status} is the HTTP status number.

pinnedDownload.differentFile.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server sent another file when the download continued.

pinnedDownload.cannotContinue.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the server could not continue a download that had stopped.

pinnedDownload.tooLarge.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: more arrived than the file's size.

pinnedDownload.notSaved.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the file could not be written. {reason} is the system's own message.

pinnedDownload.closedEarly.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the connection closed early.

pinnedDownload.mismatch.description: A download of a speech model, a font, music or a model for AI on this PC failed: the file did not match its checksum.

localAiDownload.needsMemory.description: Settings › AI on this PC: a model cannot be downloaded because this PC has too little memory. {need} and {have} are whole numbers of GB.

audioAnalysis.unreadableExit.description: Sound measurement failed and the decoder wrote nothing: {file} is a recording file name, {code} the decoder's exit code (a number, kept in Latin digits).
